meaning: A regular phrase used throughout the series, "you get me" is akin to the question, "do you understand me?" or the phrase "you know what I mean." It is used in conversation to establish whether someone has acknowledged a statement you have made

Probably one of the simpler words to identify, "bruv" is like saying "brother." However, it is not exclusive to blood relatives. The word can be used to refer to a friend or extended family member, as well as a biological brother. This is also the definition for "bredren," slang for brethren.
It is a simplified way of saying cousin. "Cuz" is often used in reference to a person belonging to the same extended family as you. But "cuz" is also commonly used to address one's friends too.
"Fam" is short for "family" but like "bruv" and "cuz" it can be used as a reference for friends too.
It is a derogatory term used to describe a worthless person, who has nothing positive going on in their lives.
It is a greeting that can be likened to "how are you?" or "what's up." Similarly, it is a way of asking your counterpart to fill you in on any details, a bit like saying, "what are you telling me?"
In Jamaican Patois "yard" means home. In the U.K., the word is also used to refer to one's residence.
A derogatory term generally used to describe a man, who does not exhibit manly qualities and is weaker in nature. Someone who is a wimp or timid.
Quite simply "p's" or "pees" is another word for money or cash.
It is a rolled-up marijuana cigarette, which can also be referred to as a "spliff" or "joint."
Used to describe anything small in stature. It is another word for "little."

A phrase commonly used in and around London to signify that what you are saying is 100 percent true and no lies were told. It is a bit like saying "the whole truth and nothing but the truth." It is said to affirm something really happened how you said it did.
The word grew in popularity among youths in 2020 and means to organize, sort out something.
The phrase is used to leave the end of a conversation on a positive note and is a way of wishing someone well, a good day/time. It can also mean "blessing(s) from the most high (a God-like figure)."
